g.text: T1: two 0.05 mm gapped ELP22 N87 halves; four primary turns, two per half-secondary.

g.text: Primary series midpoint (pin 6) is internal winding copper; no external connection.

g.text: 8 layers / 70 um copper requested. Functional isolation only; no certified safety barrier.
